annotations.title: Bulk-fetch Redfin climate risk for many properties

description: Fetch climate risk for up to 100 property URLs in a single call. Same per-property shape as `redfin_get_climate_risk`; output preserves input order. Per-row error capture — properties without First Street data return `{ available: false, reason }` without aborting the batch. Server-side concurrency (~5 fetches in flight) with retry-once-on-timeout per URL. The whole call is bounded by an overall deadline: any URL still unsettled then comes back as `status: "pending"` (retryable) with a `pending` count, so re-run just those. Use this when batching ~60-property workflows where climate risk is the dominant cost. Limitations from the per-property tool apply (no landslide coverage).

urls.description: Array of 1–100 Redfin homedetails URLs or paths.
